class.name: PhysXFlowCollider3D
class.brief_description: An explicit fluid collider for a [PhysXFlowSimulation3D], provided by the PhysX module.
class.description: Flow's collision model is collision-emitters: analytic boxes natively, voxelized triangle meshes otherwise. This node supplies those without needing a physics body -- use it for analytic volumes, animated obstacles with no [RigidBody3D], or to pull in a specific shape. Physics bodies ([StaticBody3D], [RigidBody3D], kinematic bodies) should generally go straight into [member PhysXFlowSimulation3D.colliders] instead: the simulation consumes their server-side shape, transform and velocity directly, with meshes cached per shape. This node is the explicit/override path. [member auto_velocity] estimates linear + angular velocity by finite-differencing this node's world transform between steps, so a scripted or animated collider still stirs the fluid (this also works in the editor preview). Disable it and set velocities manually for exactly-authored motion.

method.name: get_estimated_angular_velocity
method.description: The last auto-estimated angular velocity (valid after the simulation stepped).

method.name: get_estimated_linear_velocity
method.description: The last auto-estimated linear velocity (valid after the simulation stepped).

members.member: Estimate velocities by transform differencing (see the class description).
World-space angular velocity (rad/s) used when [member auto_velocity] is off.
World-space linear velocity used when [member auto_velocity] is off.
[constant SHAPE_BOX] (analytic, exact), [constant SHAPE_SPHERE] (cached icosphere mesh -- Flow has no native sphere collider), or [constant SHAPE_SHAPE3D] (mesh built from the referenced shape).

A [CollisionShape3D] to derive the collider mesh from ([constant SHAPE_SHAPE3D]). Convex shapes approximate via their bounding box, concave (trimesh) shapes voxelize exactly, other primitives fall back to a sphere of the shape's enclosing radius.
Box full size in meters, oriented by this node's transform ([constant SHAPE_BOX]).

constants.constant: Analytic box ([member size]) -- the cheapest, exact representation.
Sphere approximated by a cached icosphere mesh ([member radius]).
Mesh derived from the [member shape_source] shape.
